column1: # secret-patterns.tsv - detection patterns for secrets-sweep.sh (DATA, not a command).
# These are the regexes secrets-sweep.sh searches for INSIDE a decoded target app
# (a local directory you pass as an argument). They are search terms, not credentials,
# and nothing here is read from your machine or sent anywhere. The sweep only reads the
# local directory and prints file:line locations.
#   mode = o     -> print only the matched substring (candidate token)
#   mode = full  -> print the whole matching line (context)
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
